purpose: Teach: 寅次郎/ハーバード/義経/薩摩/アムステルダム/カタルーニャ/諏訪/福山

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが寅次郎の映画祭に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is taking you to the Tora-san film festival.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Slight lift on the news itself. Speaking to him directly, making sure he hears. Gentle but clear — this is something worth knowing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハーバード大学の動画見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched videos about Harvard.
lines.style: Quick, bright report — eager to share what he did. Small but genuine pride in the memory. Direct eye contact level. No breathiness, just simple honesty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが源義経の伝記をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father bought a biography of Minamoto no Yoshitsune.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, shared almost to herself. Slight pause before the name — noticing the weight of what he's learning. Warm recognition of his father's care in choosing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと薩摩芋を焼いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I baked sweet potatoes together.
lines.style: Simple, direct recounting. Soft warmth — a small, genuine moment he wanted to tell her. No performance, just the fact of having done it with his dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアムステルダム出張のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told us about his business trip to Amsterdam.
lines.style: Reflective delivery. Slight emphasis on 「お話」— noting that he shared this with her too. Noticing the connection being woven. Measured, warm appreciation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとカタルーニャ料理食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I tried Catalan food.
lines.style: Quick brightness, sharing the detail like a small treasure. Wondering pleasure in his voice — something new and different he experienced with his dad. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが諏訪湖の絵葉書を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father showed you a postcard from Lake Suwa.
lines.style: Gentle noticing. Slight slowness — picturing the moment. Recognizing the small tenderness of him showing it. Warm, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと福山雅治の曲聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to Masaharu Fukuyama together.
lines.style: Closing report with gentle finality. Warm and complete — another small moment shared. Soft landing, like he's finished telling her all the ways his dad was there.
